audit.whatIsWrong: Content mislabels Rakan's E (Battle Dance, the dash-to-ally/recast-shield ability) as his 'R' in four places (spikes[2].text, mid, late, wants.foe[1]) — his actual R is The Quickness, a non-dash charm. missingInteractions also flagged that his Q sustain (Gleaming Quill) needing Grievous Wounds timing is absent from the page.
audit.why: enemyKit confirms E carries the dash+shield+recast flags and R has no dash flag at all — the four fields would send a reader to the wrong keybind for his disengage tool.
audit.corrected: Swapped R->E for Battle Dance in all four fields; folded the anti-heal timing gap into dosFull[1].d (also fixing its copy-paste bleed).

edits.before: This is a skill window: your P pull plus item damage rewards catching him, but a good Rakan uses R Battle Dance and E shields to disengage cleanly, so who wins the item spike depends on landing E.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 flatten to a skill matchup: it comes down to whether you land E on his W Grand Entrance or he dashes it with R Battle Dance. Ward for his flank roams since his mobility makes him a strong roamer, and at 6 your R tips the engage war back to you if you catch him committing.

edits.before: Rakan out-scales you into two items: his double-dash R plus W range let him charm and peel your carry while staying out of your immobile E range. Track both his dashes, group with your team so he can't isolate you, and don't chase a Rakan who has R up.
